other_conditions: The applicant must be a farmer residing in Rajasthan
The agricultural land must be owned by the applicant
The farmer must have at least 0.2 hectares of irrigated cultivable land
Installation must follow departmental norms after administrative approval of the Horticulture Department
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 70% for general farmers and up to 75% for small and marginal (including SC/ST women) farmers.
